description: This file contains test cases for the 'host_orchestrator_client' package, which appears to be a Golang client library interacting with Google's Android Cuttlefish frontend services. The tests validate functions related to uploading files, handling retries with exponential backoff, and creating CVDs (Cloud Virtual Devices).

methods.name: TestUploadFileChunkSizeBytesIsZeroPanic
methods.description: Tests that uploading a file with zero chunk size causes a panic.

methods.name: TestUploadFileSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies successful upload of multiple files using chunks, with mock server handling chunk uploads.

methods.name: TestUploadFileExponentialBackoff
methods.description: Tests exponential backoff logic during file upload retries.

methods.name: TestUploadFileExponentialBackoffReachedElapsedTime
methods.description: Ensures that retries respect the maximum elapsed time during exponential backoff.

methods.name: TestCreateCVD
methods.description: Tests creating a CVD and waiting for its creation operation to complete.

methods.name: TestCreateCVDWithUserProjectOverride
methods.description: Tests creating a CVD with custom user project ID and access token headers.
